tone.target: bright clean reggae-pop rhythm with slight chorus sheen
tone.profile: bright clean reggae-pop rhythm with slight chorus sheen
tone.summary: A classic reggae/pop rhythm tone achieved using a Fender-style clean amp (US Deluxe), light compression for staccato attack, Chorus for sheen, and minimal Room reverb.

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain clarity for staccato rhythm playing.
Provide light compression to enhance the staccato attack and punch of the rhythm guitar.
Keep the tone clean and avoid any thick crunch or distortion.
Simulate the bright, clean, single-coil sound of a Fender-style amplifier.
Provide a bright and articulate cabinet sound suitable for clean pop rhythm.
Enhance the bright treble and cut unnecessary low-end mud while maintaining clarity.
No wah effect needed for this reggae-pop rhythm tone.
Add a subtle 'sheen' and width to the clean rhythm tone without sounding overly wet.
Delay is not required for the core rhythm tone.
Provide a small, natural room ambience to give the tone depth without sounding like deep reverb.

improvements.summary: The current IR is good but could be optimized for maximum brightness and articulation needed for reggae-pop rhythm.

proposals.reason: Enhance brightness and clarity for staccato rhythm playing.
